name: Jet Amplifier - First Strike
RelatedDescription: This jetpack enables an ST to fly over short distances, quickly traversing obstacles to reach even the most inaccessible corners of the battlefield. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's First Strike capability.

61211.name: Flying Device I · First Strike
61211.SpecificEffects:
ST Move Method changes to levitation, enabling ST to pass over low obstacles.
On the <color=#F74848>1st</color> active attack per turn, DMG <color=#F74848>+7.5%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
